seerr.description:
Request management and media discovery tool for your Plex ecosystem, integrating with Sonarr and Radarr.

Based on a custom OCI image, available for amd64 and arm64 architecture.

/app/config.description: Configuration and database. Minimum Size: 1 Gigabyte. Must be owned by the UID:GID as (1000:1000).
/app/config.label: Config Storage [e.g. seerr-config]
